purpose: One-time account-wide R2 usage diagnostic using a lower-cardinality operations aggregation after V0.2 reached the 10000-group cap.

execution.history_check: One Actions workflow-runs metadata request; prior or ambiguous V0.3 runs fail closed.
execution.readiness: Separate repeatable zero-network V0.3 readiness must report READY on current main.
execution.account_id_source: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID Secret; require nonempty equality with the same-named Variable before network access.

r2_storage.name: r2StorageAdaptiveGroups
r2_storage.aggregate: latest returned snapshot per bucket, names held in memory only

forbidden_operations: Rerun V0.1, V0.2, or V0.3; retry or paginate Cloudflare requests.
List, read, write, or delete R2 objects; use S3 credentials.
D1 inventory, SQL, migration, provisioning, or writes.
Provider calls, market data, holdout, training, promotion, trading, or schedule activation.
Infer account-wide free headroom, every external writer, or zero cost from this R2-only analytics response.
